tools.name: ask-vercel
tools.description: Open Vercel's AI chat and submit a question about Vercel products, documentation, pricing, or platform capabilities.

tools.name: vercel.open_documentation
tools.description: Open the Vercel documentation homepage. Use this when the user wants technical guidance about Vercel products or platform features.

tools.name: vercel.open_plugin
tools.description: Open the Vercel plugin. Use it to work with Vercel projects, deployments, and platform resources.

tools.name: vercel.open_sales_contact_form
tools.description: Navigate to the Vercel sales contact form, where the user can share their requirements with the sales team.

tools.name: vercel.start_deployment_flow
tools.description: Navigate to Vercel's new project flow, where the user can import a repository or start from a template before creating a deployment.
